$Comment: The Headless Horseman in the saddle on the hard ride, the form his hard fight (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard) opens with: a Variant of his normal ride's Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, so he flies and fights as that file says, through the same Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride, and Modify names only the Parameters it declares for what the hard ride changes: more health, the hard name, his armour in gold (his Appearance, the model Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM), and one attack the normal ride lacks: he hurls a lantern bomb (Root_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Bomb) at a player within 18 blocks, but only after aiming at them for 3 seconds (RangedAttackAimingRange, the game's own flier aim tell, as its void eyes do: the template's Aim head motion keeps him turned on that player the whole time), then waits 2 to 3 seconds (RangedAttackPauseRange) before he aims again. The hard fight swaps him to Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_HM on foot and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal that role's. Its own _CombatConfig replaces the normal ride's whole, so it lists both effects: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Fire_Ward (fire hurts him at half) and Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Hard_Mode, which makes what he swings and throws hit harder. A key the normal ride does not declare under Parameters makes the game refuse the whole role.
